Key.Original: Force a specific Koppen biome (leave empty for auto-detect). Options: Af, Am, Aw, BWh, BWk, BSh, BSk, Csa, Csb, Cfa, Cfb, Dfa, Dfb, Dfc, ET, EF
Key.English: Force a specific Koppen biome (leave empty for auto-detect). Options: Af, Am, Aw, BWh, BWk, BSh, BSk, Csa, Csb, Cfa, Cfb, Dfa, Dfb, Dfc, ET, EF

Key.Original: Multiply rain accumulation. 1.0 = normal, 0.0 = no rain, 2.0 = double
Key.English: Multiply rain accumulation. 1.0 = normal, 0.0 = no rain, 2.0 = double

Key.Original: Add a fixed offset to all temperatures
Key.English: Add a fixed offset to all temperatures

Key.Original: Multiply wind speed. 1.0 = normal, 0.0 = calm, 2.0 = double
Key.English: Multiply wind speed. 1.0 = normal, 0.0 = calm, 2.0 = double

Key.Original: Configure AEE environment simulation parameters for this mission. Place in the mission editor, set attributes, and AEE will use them during initialization.
Key.English: Configure AEE environment simulation parameters for this mission. Place in the mission editor, set attributes, and AEE will use them during initialization.

Key.Original: Calculate density altitude and true air density using temperature, pressure, and humidity corrections
Key.English: Calculate density altitude and true air density using temperature, pressure, and humidity corrections

Key.Original: Enable lightning strike risk, severe weather (sandstorm, blizzard, dust devil), microburst downdrafts, low-level turbulence, and avalanche risk in mountain terrain
Key.English: Enable lightning strike risk, severe weather (sandstorm, blizzard, dust devil), microburst downdrafts, low-level turbulence, and avalanche risk in mountain terrain

Key.Original: Use Köppen climate classification to differentiate biome types and their weather characteristics
Key.English: Use Köppen climate classification to differentiate biome types and their weather characteristics

Key.Original: Smoothing radius (m) for biome boundary transitions to avoid hard climatic edges
Key.English: Smoothing radius (m) for biome boundary transitions to avoid hard climatic edges

Key.Original: Enable verbose diagnostic logging (diag_log) for environment state changes
Key.English: Enable verbose diagnostic logging (diag_log) for environment state changes

Key.Original: Master switch for the AEE environment simulation module
Key.English: Master switch for the AEE environment simulation module

Key.Original: Reduce ground-vehicle engine power in hot+high conditions using density-altitude derating (piston + turbo models); sets QGVAR(enginePowerModifier) and QGVAR(engineTurboModifier)
Key.English: Reduce ground-vehicle engine power in hot+high conditions using density-altitude derating (piston + turbo models); sets QGVAR(enginePowerModifier) and QGVAR(engineTurboModifier)

Key.Original: Enable biological ambient sound intensity, scent dispersion vector, sea state (Beaufort/wave height), and magnetic compass deviation
Key.English: Enable biological ambient sound intensity, scent dispersion vector, sea state (Beaufort/wave height), and magnetic compass deviation

Key.Original: Enable relative-humidity tracking and condensation/precipitation calculations
Key.English: Enable relative-humidity tracking and condensation/precipitation calculations

Key.Original: Enable snow accumulation/melt and drifting, flash flood risk in arid terrain after heavy rain, and freeze-thaw state cycling with hysteresis
Key.English: Enable snow accumulation/melt and drifting, flash flood risk in arid terrain after heavy rain, and freeze-thaw state cycling with hysteresis

Key.Original: Reference altitude (m MSL) for the ICAO standard atmosphere baseline
Key.English: Reference altitude (m MSL) for the ICAO standard atmosphere baseline

Key.Original: Radius (m) for local terrain and vegetation microclimate effects (valley cool-air pooling, forest canopy)
Key.English: Radius (m) for local terrain and vegetation microclimate effects (valley cool-air pooling, forest canopy)

Key.Original: Enable mud build-up on vehicle wheels/tracks when driving on muddy terrain
Key.English: Enable mud build-up on vehicle wheels/tracks when driving on muddy terrain

Key.Original: Enable thermal contrast, mirage/heat haze, smoke dispersal persistence, precipitation visibility reduction, and solar glare from low-elevation sun
Key.English: Enable thermal contrast, mirage/heat haze, smoke dispersal persistence, precipitation visibility reduction, and solar glare from low-elevation sun

Key.Original: Enable orographic-lifting precipitation enhancement on windward slopes
Key.English: Enable orographic-lifting precipitation enhancement on windward slopes

Key.Original: Compute atmospheric propagation index (temp inversions, humidity, pressure) for VHF/UHF range effects; sets QGVAR(radioPropagationIndex)
Key.English: Compute atmospheric propagation index (temp inversions, humidity, pressure) for VHF/UHF range effects; sets QGVAR(radioPropagationIndex)

Key.Original: Override reference altitude (m MSL) for station pressure calculations. 0 = auto-detect from unit position
Key.English: Override reference altitude (m MSL) for station pressure calculations. 0 = auto-detect from unit position

Key.Original: Enable diurnal temperature variation based on solar elevation angle
Key.English: Enable diurnal temperature variation based on solar elevation angle

Key.Original: Enable elevation-based temperature lapse rate (standard atmosphere ~6.5 °C/km)
Key.English: Enable elevation-based temperature lapse rate (standard atmosphere ~6.5 °C/km)

Key.Original: Temperature lapse rate in °C per 1000 m (default: 6.5 °C/km, ICAO standard)
Key.English: Temperature lapse rate in °C per 1000 m (default: 6.5 °C/km, ICAO standard)

Key.Original: Simulation update interval in seconds (lower = more frequent updates)
Key.English: Simulation update interval in seconds (lower = more frequent updates)

Key.Original: Magnitude of urban heat-island temperature boost in built-up areas (0 = none, 1 = full)
Key.English: Magnitude of urban heat-island temperature boost in built-up areas (0 = none, 1 = full)

Key.Original: Radius (m) over which large water bodies moderate local temperature and humidity
Key.English: Radius (m) over which large water bodies moderate local temperature and humidity

Key.Original: Enable dynamic wind simulation with terrain and thermal influences
Key.English: Enable dynamic wind simulation with terrain and thermal influences

Key.Original: Relative frequency of gust events (0 = calm, 1 = very gusty)
Key.English: Relative frequency of gust events (0 = calm, 1 = very gusty)

Key.Original: Strength of terrain (ridge channelling, valley funnelling) on wind vectors (0..1)
Key.English: Strength of terrain (ridge channelling, valley funnelling) on wind vectors (0..1)
